summary: Object.values collects an object’s own enumerable string-keyed property values.
documentation: Object.values collects an object’s own enumerable string-keyed property values. It does not include inherited values or symbol-keyed properties. Its ordering follows object property enumeration rules.
returns: An array of its own enumerable values.
caution: Numeric-looking keys have special enumeration order. Sort the returned values explicitly when output order is part of a report.
scenarios: Collect numeric stock counts from a product lookup.
Build a list of configured display labels.
Inspect local settings without needing their field names.
title: Sort stored quantities
problem: Input is an object mapping names to integer quantities. Return all its values sorted in numeric ascending order. Keep duplicates, zeroes and negative adjustments.
goal: Use Object.values() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Collect values, then use a numeric sorting comparator.
